_note: Candidate registry for New Mexico 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (New Mexico Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Contest/Candidate List (candidate portal, all counties, with Ballot Order and Status columns), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: New Mexico Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Contest/Candidate List (candidate portal, all counties, with Ballot Order and Status columns) (https://candidateportal.servis.sos.state.nm.us/CandidateList.aspx?eid=2917&cty=99); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
